api_url.description: Full URL of the LogisticsAI raw message endpoint.

analysis_url_template.description: Optional second-stage analysis URL template. Leave empty to use {api_url}/{database_id}/analysis.

api_token.description: Backend API token. Leave empty when authentication is not required.
api_token.hint: For Authorization, enter either a raw token or Bearer followed by the token.

token_header.description: HTTP request header used for the API token.

timeout.description: Total timeout in seconds for each backend HTTP request.

retry_count.description: Number of retries after a failed backend request, from 0 to 10.

retry_interval.description: Initial retry delay in seconds. Later retries use exponential backoff.

verify_ssl.description: Verify the backend TLS certificate for HTTPS requests.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent backend HTTP requests.

multimodal_analysis_enabled.description: Silently analyze current-message images with AstrBot's active model. Keep disabled until the backend analysis endpoint is deployed.

multimodal_analysis_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for one AstrBot multimodal model request.

multimodal_analysis_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent multimodal model requests, from 1 to 4.

multimodal_analysis_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for structured multimodal extraction, from 0.0 to 1.0.
